title: TikTok Video Details - Views, Likes & Hashtags
description: Minimal input {"videoUrls": ["https://www.tiktok.com/@apifytech/video/7398101551744552225", "https://www.tiktok.com/@scout2015/video/6718335390845095173"], "maxResults": 3, "maxSources": 2}. $0.002 per valid source check plus $0.002 per delivered video. Filtered sources are paid. No start fee. maxTotalChargeUsd is a run option.

videoUrls.title: Video urls
videoUrls.description: Required full TikTok video URLs, e.g. ["https://www.tiktok.com/@apifytech/video/7398101551744552225"]. Up to 100. No short links, profile URLs, numeric IDs alone or photo posts. Each valid video check costs a source fee plus its delivered-row fee. No comments or media downloads.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the ENTIRE run after filters, exclusions and deduplication; default 20, range 1–1000. Earlier targets can fill it. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in Apify run options for a dollar cap, not inside input JSON. A result cap does not expand source coverage.

minViews.title: Min views
minViews.description: Minimum public view count, e.g. 1000; 0 disables. Missing views fail an active threshold. Instagram often omits views even for reels; leave 0 when views are not required. Filters supplied URLs before maxResults. No filter fee; valid checks remain paid.

minLikes.title: Min likes
minLikes.description: Minimum public like count, e.g. 100; 0 disables. Hidden or missing likes fail an active threshold. Filters supplied posts/videos before maxResults, without discovering new URLs. No filter fee; valid source checks remain paid.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Optional ISO date/time, e.g. "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"; "" disables. Keeps social posts/videos published at or after it. Date-only values use midnight UTC. Filters supplied URLs only, without discovering posts or reducing the source fee. Applied before maxResults.

textContains.title: Text contains
textContains.description: Optional case-insensitive OR phrases, e.g. ["python", "developer"]. Matches title, caption/snippet/description, author, company or developer fields when present. [] disables. Filters before maxResults. Skipped rows have no row fee; valid source checks are paid.

maxSources.title: Max sources
maxSources.description: Maximum attempted source targets across the run; default 20, range 1–100. One post/video URL, Indeed query/location/country, or Play query-or-ID/country counts as one. Failed targets count toward this limit but have no event fee. Valid filtered sources are paid; retries add no source fee.

excludeIds.title: Exclude ids
excludeIds.description: Prior dataset id values, e.g. [] on a first run; up to 5,000. Skips identities even when changed. For Google Play use the full app:country:language id. Excluded rows are free but valid checks are paid. Keep history in your workflow; no automatic persistence.

excludeContentHashes.title: Exclude content hashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior content_hash values, e.g. [] initially; up to 5,000 SHA-256 hashes. Skips unchanged observations while allowing updates. Do not also exclude IDs when changes matter. Time, search position, image URLs and relative-date labels do not affect hashes. Valid source checks remain paid; no stored history.
